name: deepseek-supervisor
description: Evidence-based supervision for any side model: defaults to the current worker and validates observations without assuming superior model capability.

verifier_model.title: Verifier model
verifier_model.description: Optional side model ID or host alias. Empty follows the current worker model. No capability ranking or model-ID relationship check; no automatic fallback on refusal.

review_changes.title: Review each turn's change
review_changes.description: At the end of a turn that changed code, the verifier also reads the change for a defect a command can show.

execution_mode.title: Independent execution
execution_mode.description: off by default. shadow runs isolated checks without feedback; enabled sends advisory findings. macOS only; unsupported workspaces remain read-only.

assistance_mode.title: Experimental assistance
assistance_mode.description: existing (default), facts (legacy location help), supervise (requirements, plan, architecture, direction and validation review), probe or recovery (single-action review). One shared model flow and budget; record rules remain active.

review_phase.title: Semantic review phase
review_phase.description: auto (default) or plan, exploration, implementation, failure, completion. Defer semantic admission until the selected evidence-based phase; never fall back to an earlier phase or add budget. Unknown values disable semantic calls. Record rules stay active.
